title: Validate XSD instance hint order without fetching resources
api_or_output: Apply the declared XSD1.0 hint-order profile with no instance resource fetching or API change

acceptance.description: Freeze the explicit project interpretation in the owned decision before runtime edits: check global validation-root hint ordering independently of fetching, including skipped subtree names/hints without enabling skipped type/content/lexical assessment. Preserve that this skip corner is a project interpretation, not a W3C-adjudicated oracle. Reproduce and preserve the seven exact original failures/statuses/hashes from the coordinator triage.

Add only SchemaHints.cs and minimal Evaluator.Enter hook. A per-validation ordinal set tracks earlier physical element/attribute namespace names. Check every hint namespace against preceding tags before recording the entire current tag; same-tag order is irrelevant. Empty namespace is real; namespace declarations, QName values and hint tokens/locations do not establish use. Report one source-located ordering error per offending hint attribute, preserve normal typed values/identity hooks, no fetching or document mutation.

Complete all seven unchanged original instances as invalid using explicitly compiled original first-hint schemas. Verify same-tag permutations, first-use and prior attribute-only use, unqualified attributes, repeated/multiple hints, non-use declarations/QName values, explicit skip interpretation and preserved skip behavior, lexical errors, recovery after a content failure and zero resolver calls. No invalid-pass credit from a refusal or missing prerequisite.

Preserve charged borrowed scanning, ordinal comparisons, bounded per-run retention and no global state. Prove exact/one-short work/diagnostic limits, cancellation inside long tokens/comparisons with null caps, source locations, repeat/concurrent isolation and immutability. Pass affected evaluator/identity/facade checks, unchanged public/frozen APIs, normal and true XML-only consumers, planning validation and actual allocation evidence through existing infrastructure under a fresh root lease.

handoff.summary: Planned ordered evaluator-only repair after root/independent source/main scope review. No-fetch suppresses acquisition, not hint-order checking. Exact accepted project interpretation and original pins in coordinator brief/triage. No implementation before verified content-failure prerequisite.
